name: Marble★Bloomers
source:
Hiroki loves bloomers and now works hard for preparation for sports day. Runa, who gets sexually excited when wearing bloomers, and Saki, who suddenly tells Hiroki that she loves him. Well, which girl (bloomers) will Hiroki choose...?

[From Eroge Shop]
